title: The dry fast checks (STE lint, split guard, cost pins, scaffold, debt retire, open-PR clash) run on each PR before it is marked ready
why: Owner ruling own-826-a-now-build-b (02:14 CST Nov 14, relayed): per-lane merge by priority now, with quick checks before each ready mark. Consultant 02:13 CST (relayed from runner 10's 02:12 answer; unchecked by triage): of the four failed combines, three (#3361 split guard, #3363 STE lint, #3360 open-PR clash) would have dropped in seconds on a dry-tree fast check; each combine's first check was the 24 to 27 min lane lint instead. Lane measure 03:19 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 03:18, from the lane; unchecked by triage): the open-PR clash check took 13 to 44 s over all open PRs, and 7 of 8 test PRs failed it. The coordinator picked scope b (only ready PRs count for the clash) as a lane default; it is the coordinator's own pick, undoable, not an owner word. HAND-IN 06:10 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 06:10, relayed; lane items as data; triage read nothing): #3397 (draft, head 15c1a83ed819, record 6876975037, lane lint PASS per the lane, at runner 10). Lane note 1: the STE lint and debt-close read the merge tool's checkout linter, not the dry merge's (debt note pre-ready-ste-reads-merge-checkout-linter). Lane note 2: merge.py header lines 19-20 still say the cost is one ci-job run and one worktree; stale; left as a review note because a push would void the record. Not fixed. DONE 10:17 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 10:16, relayed; triage read no diff and ran no test): #3397 merged 10:14:40 CST (REST merged true 16:14:40Z), main 4c7e4e2ad7b90c242bb223463181766eb34d79fc (ls-remote matches). `merge <pr> --ready` is in main. Runner 10 uses it from #3389 on (coordinator ruling 13, its own).
source: Neighbours to read first: merge-runs-repo-checks, lane-lint-before-push, merge-main-silent-undo-precheck (each runs some check earlier or in the merge tool), combine-tournament (its design held per-round fast checks that did not run), own-ready-by-priority (the ready mark is by priority and live queue state; these checks sit just before that mark). The check list is the consultant's: STE lint, split guard, cost pins, scaffold, debt retire, open-PR clash. Cost: must run in seconds on a dry tree, or it is not a fast check.
note: Triage 02:18 CST Nov 14: done check: a runner's ready mark for a PR first runs the six checks on a dry merge of the PR onto main, printing one verdict line each (pass, fail by name, or unknown), in under about a minute (measured on at least five PRs before it counts as fast; no estimate until then); a PR that fails one goes back to its lane by name. Red first: a PR with an open-PR clash and one with a split-guard break each fail the pre-ready run in seconds; control: a clean PR passes. Home: the merge tool or the runner's wake (the lane reads merge-runs-repo-checks first to avoid a second home, rule building-one-home-per-capability). A tool change that adds checks, not a guard verdict change; own lane, tracker the coordinator, path ALONE. Not started. Lane started 02:19 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 02:18, relayed): tracker the coordinator, path ALONE; the lane measures each check on at least five real open PRs and extends the home of merge-runs-repo-checks (no second home).
